patch.value: To Determine Maximum Tolerated Dose for Use in the Phase II Portion of the Trial

This phase of the study uses the Bayesian Optimal Interval (BOIN) design with a 3+3 run-in to identify the maximum tolerable dose (MTD).
Patients are treated in cohorts of 3 with a maximum of 27 participants.
Starting with Neratinib PO dose level 1 (120 mg for Dose 1-7, then 160 mg) combined with Capmatinib PO level 1 (400 mg), with up to 12 patients per dose.
The target toxicity rate for the MTD is 25%.
To Determine Overall Response Rate (ORR: CR+PR)
To assess the overall response rate (ORR) for patients treated at the MTD.
